systems.country_label: Bilhete de Identidade de Cidadão Nacional; its number serves as the Número Único do Cidadão (NUC)
systems.owner: the service competent to issue the Bilhete de Identidade (not named)

systems.system: Base de Dados de Cidadão Maior
systems.country_label: Base de Dados de Cidadão Maior
systems.tiers: not stated; the database against which a voter card's data are confirmed

systems.system: Transmission of identity-card files to the civil registry
systems.country_label: remessa oficiosa de cópia do processo para a Conservatória de Registo Civil competente
systems.owner: the service competent to issue the Bilhete de Identidade
systems.tiers: from the identity-card service to the competent Conservatória de Registo Civil, where a card is issued on a voter card (art. 20(6)); the medium is not stated

note: An identity-card law: it names the birth entry and the civil registry office only as the documents an application rests on and as the recipient of a copy of the file; nothing on how the office makes the record of a birth or death.
